description: Start or retry a project-scoped agent session and record its goal. Returns record.id, the session ID for later writes in this session. Does not run an agent or change repository files.

expectedVersion.description: Current version of the target record from its latest read or mutation result. A stale value causes a version conflict; re-read before retrying.

idempotencyKey.description: Caller-generated retry key. Reuse the same key and identical payload only to retry the same mutation; use a new key for a new action.

projectId.description: Owned Brain Scanner project ID from the account's project list; not a local path or repository URL.

requestText.description: User request or goal to record at the start of this session.

sessionId.description: ID of this project's active agent session, returned when the session was started. Not needed for read-only calls.

name: start_agent_session
title: Start agent session
